title: Separate nested trays and park them for reuse
instruction: Separate the orange inner tray from the blue outer tray. Leave both upright in their matching outlined bays and let go of both.
context: Denesting reusable containers before a packing, laboratory or food-service operation.
setup: Two empty rigid plastic trays nested at (0.25, 0) on the calibrated YAM table. Outer tray 160x180 mm, 160 g; inner tray 130x140 mm, 100 g. Raised grasp tabs on opposite sides. Bay centres (0.25, +0.23) and (0.25, -0.23) m. Full geometry and fixed starting poses are in task.py and README.md.
scoring: 0 for invalid, held, moving or nested state; 0.5 for both released and stable on the table with at least 10 mm horizontal separation; 1.0 additionally requires each tray body centre within 20 mm of its bay centre, maintained for 2 seconds. Tilt <8 degrees and yaw error <10 degrees. Detailed numeric tolerances in README.md.
run_limit: 800 control steps (40 simulated seconds at 20 Hz)
reset_notes: Fixed poses, zero jitter. Reset both trays and both arms before every episode.
fidelity: Rigid compound-box trays with physical gripper contact and friction. Loose clearance; no suction, elastic deformation, snap-fit or damage model. Real hardware not tested.
scores: Dream-1: pending a valid completed evaluation; earlier API-interrupted recordings are not reported as model failures. Scripted demo: 1.0 in 2/2 episodes, 519 steps (25.95 simulated seconds) each, with this packaged scorer and runner.
